faqs.question: Are my files uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. Everything is executed entirely inside your device's browser memory. Zero bytes leave your device.

faqs.question: How can I verify this privacy guarantee?
faqs.answer: Open your browser Developer Tools (F12), switch to the Network tab, and observe that exactly 0 network requests are made during processing.
